description: Pause this mailbox's warmup. It sends no warmup mail and keeps its day on the ramp. It stays in the pool, so partners still write to it. Resume it with start_mailbox_warmup.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: pause_mailbox_warmup
title: Pause a mailbox's warmup
